_comment: Every creature in the Age is rooted where it stands (Jonah, 2026-10-12): it cannot walk, fly or jump, but
still turns to watch you and still strikes or shoots at whatever comes into reach. Strange, and whole at
one step: there is nothing to dial.
Only in an Age where something lives, since a lifeless one would show nothing.
Never bought where the book set `inhabitants.still`.
